title: Finite H-Tilt Constructed Diagonal Shift
summary: A Lean-verified theorem constructing an explicit finite shift c = sum_i |K_ii| that makes every shifted diagonal entry K_ii + c nonnegative. Combined with off-diagonal nonnegativity, this yields entrywise nonnegativity of the shifted operator A=cI+K.

proves: For every finite real operator K, the explicit scalar c = sum_i |K_ii| makes all shifted diagonal entries K_ii + c nonnegative.
If K has nonnegative off-diagonal entries, then the shifted operator A=cI+K is entrywise nonnegative for this explicit c.
does_not_prove: That c+lambda is nonzero or positive.
Identification of the shifted eigenvalue c+lambda with any Perron root.
